Scenario Description: Successful Login via Vi Mobile Number (OTP)
Gherkin Feature / Automation Script Blue:
Feature: Vi Movies Login
  Scenario: Successful login with valid mobile number and OTP
    Given the user opens the Vi Movies app or website
    When the user enters a valid 10-digit Vi mobile number "9876543210"
    And clicks on the "Generate OTP" button
    And enters the received 4-digit or 6-digit valid OTP
    And clicks on "Verify & Login"
    Then the user should be successfully redirected to the Home Screen
    And the user profile icon should be visible.
Automation Target Elements:
Input Field: `input[type="tel"]` or `id="mobileNumber"`
Button: `id="sendOtp"` or `text="Generate OTP"`
OTP Field: `id="otpInput"`
Submit: `id="verifyOtp"`

Scenario Description: Browse and Validate Live TV Channel Playback
Gherkin Feature / Automation Script Blue:
Feature: Live TV Streaming
  Scenario: Stream a live TV channel
    Given the user is logged into the Vi Movies platform
    When the user navigates to the "Live TV" tab
    And clicks on the first active channel banner (e.g., "Aaj Tak")
    Then the video player element should be initialized
    And the player state should change to "playing"
    And the video streaming should not throw any 404 or network errors.
Automation Target Elements:
Live TV Tab: `a[href="/live-tv"]` or `id="liveTvTab"`
Channel Card: `xpath=//div[@class="channel-card"][1]`
Video Player: `video` tag or `id="viPlayer"`

Scenario Description: Search Content with Voice or Text and Validate Results
Gherkin Feature / Automation Script Blue:
Feature: Content Search
  Scenario: Search for a premium movie
    Given the user is on the Vi Movies home page
    When the user types "Mirzapur" into the search bar
    And presses Enter or clicks the search icon
    Then the search results grid should display at least one item
    And the title text of the first result should contain "Mirzapur".
Automation Target Elements:
Search Bar: `input[placeholder*="Search"]` or `id="searchBar"`
Search Results: `div.search-result-item` or `xpath=//h3[contains(text(),"Mirzapur")]`

Gherkin Feature / Automation Script Blue:
Feature: Paywall Enforcement
  Scenario: Non-VIP user attempts to stream VIP content
    Given the user is logged in with a basic/non-active plan account
    When the user navigates to a premium movie details page
    And clicks on the "Watch Now" button
    Then the video player should not start playing
    And a subscription pop-up or plan selection page should be displayed.

Feature: Content Filtering
  Scenario: Filter movies by Hindi language
    Given the user is in the "Movies" section
    When the user opens the "Language" filter dropdown
    And selects "Hindi"
    Then all displayed movie cards should match the Hindi language attribute.
Automation Target Elements:
Movies Section: `id="moviesTab"`
Filter Dropdown: `id="langFilter"`
Checkbox/Item: `input[value="Hindi"]`
Movie Grid: `.movie-card[data-lang="Hindi"]`
